crossComponentPatterns: Whitespace carries hierarchy more than separators or color blocks.
Rounded-full actions and large radii soften otherwise minimal surfaces.
Copy stays concise and often uses editorial commerce phrasing.
Accent color is concentrated in CTA moments rather than background coverage.
Photography-first layouts keep the UI deferential to content.

iconAssets.coloringRule: Icon color must come from the consuming element's token-driven color via css mask + background-color; never hardcode fill values.
iconAssets.gapNotes: Library has no settings/gear/sliders icon; the settings entry falls back to a Lucide-compatible outline glyph and is disclosed at delivery.

pages.title: 桌面待机 · 鲸鱼常驻
qualityRisks: full-bleed desktop stage must not clip or overflow horizontally
mascot PNG aspect ratio must be preserved at 664x1024
dark theme contrast against wallpaper must stay at or above 4.5:1

supplementaryReads.reason: layout-risk page needs critical-layout css discipline

pages.title: 悬停展开 · 四项快捷菜单
qualityRisks: overlay must preserve the underlying idle stage context
scrim and every close control need hide-edge interactions
library has no gear icon; settings entry uses a disclosed fallback glyph

pages.title: 余额气泡 · 峰时计价
qualityRisks: balance figure must read as first-level information without extra font weights
peak/off-peak chip must differ only by declared mutable regions from the off-peak sibling
bubble must stay anchored to the whale without clipping at the stage edge

pages.title: 余额气泡 · 谷时计价
qualityRisks: must stay visually identical to the peak sibling except the peak/off-peak chip and discount copy
single accent treatment only; no second brand color
bubble must stay anchored to the whale without clipping at the stage edge

pages.title: 设置面板 · 账号与刷新
qualityRisks: form controls must reuse the input contract instead of custom component css
API Key field must be masked and must not display any real credential
modal scrim plus cancel and back controls all need hide-edge interactions
